'''2011 Belgium Regionals Floris de Vries LS Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Gungans
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
